thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency > 3500ms for /v1/generate (service: inference-api, region: us-west-2) — PagerDuty page fired to SRE rotation. AlertID=A-178800

morgan: ack — I'm on it, grabbing recent traces and logs

morgan: quick look: KV cache miss rate spiked, concurrent batch sizes hitting 60+, p95 elevated as well. tagging @sam @jia

sam: @morgan any deploys or config changes in last 30m?

morgan: no deploys. autoscaler shows some nodes removed around 14:02 UTC, looks like preemptions in us-west-2a

jia: confirmed — three spot nodes preempted, fallback capacity is slower than expected, some traffic falling to smaller sidecar pools

sam: can we divert traffic or switch to dedicated pool as fallback?

morgan: initiating fallback routing: execute -> console: `rb traffic-rule set --match "/v1/generate" --reroute us-east-dedicated --weight 10%`

morgan: executed, verifying traces for rerouted requests

incident-bot: ACTION: traffic re-route applied (10% -> us-east-dedicated) — rule id trf-3421

sam: good. also reduce batcher size to reduce tail: `rb update batcher.max_size=8 --model rdx-prod-v2`

morgan: lowered batcher.max_size to 8 for rdx-prod-v2. applying small KV-cache warmup for hot prefixes (prompt signatures)

jia: spinning up 2 on-demand hot nodes in us-west-2 now (skip spot pool). Requesting ~3-4m for node readiness

morgan: noted. p99 on rerouted subset dropped to ~900ms, main us-west still noisy

sam: telemetry — p99 overall trending 3500 -> 1700 after routing + batch change, still above SLO. continue monitoring

morgan: preliminary customer impact calc: ~2.4% requests either timed out or returned degraded responses in last 5m. drafting notice for CS

morgan: draft for #customer-notify: "We're investigating elevated latency impacting a subset of API requests in US-West. We've applied temporary routing and capacity increases; mitigation is in progress. We expect improvements within 15-30 minutes and will update you as we have more details."

sam: send it, and add that PD escalation to Eng Infra if p99 > 1500ms in 10m

morgan: notice posted to #customer-notify and pinned to the incident thread

incident-bot: NOTE: PagerDuty escalation policy will escalate to Eng Infra in 10m if p99 threshold persists

jia: hot on-demand nodes are up and joined the pool. KV miss rate is trending down. I'll follow up with an autoscaler policy change to prefer on-demand minimums during high-tailed workloads

sam: plan for post-incident: timeline, root cause (spot preemptions), autoscaler tuning, and make fallback routing an automated step at 20% traffic on preemption events

morgan: :thumbsup: I'll prepare runbook notes and hand off to evening oncall in 20m, will include commands I ran and links to traces/dashboards

alex: ack handoff, I'll monitor for the next 30m and escalate if p99 > 1500 persists

morgan: thanks — keeping this thread updated with any regressions or rollback actions
